mapper.insert: insert into it_message (receiver, title, content, msg_type, biz_type, biz_id, link, read_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{receiver}, #{title}, #{content}, #{msgType}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{link}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select count(1) from it_message where receiver = #{receiver} and read_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update it_message set read_flag = '1' where message_id = #{messageId} and receiver = #{receiver} and read_flag = '0'
